sources.title: Vambient's Comprehensive Challenger Jungle Guide for Season 16 on Rek'Sai

passive.name: Fury of the Xer'Sai
passive.text: Rek'Sai generates Fury by Attacking and hitting with basic Abilities. She consumes this Fury while Burrowed to restore health.

spells.name: Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker
spells.text: Rek'Sai's next 3 basic attacks deal bonus Physical Damage to nearby enemies.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai launches a burst of void-charged earth that damages and reveals enemies hit.

spells.name: Burrow / Un-burrow
spells.text: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, gaining new abilities and increased Move Speed. Her vision range is reduced and she cannot use basic attacks.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai may cast Unburrow to knock up and damage nearby enemies.

spells.name: Furious Bite / Tunnel
spells.text: Rek'Sai bites her target, dealing physical damage, or bonus true damage if she has max Fury.While Burrowed, Rek'Sai creates a re-usable, long lasting tunnel. Enemies can destroy it by standing on top of either entrance.

spells.name: Void Rush
spells.text: Rek'Sai passively marks targets by damaging them. She can activate this ability to become briefly untargetable and lunge at a marked target for heavy damage based on their maximum health.

damage.value: Rek'Sai deals physical damage with attacks and abilities, bonus true damage with a max-Fury bite, and heavy burst with Void Rush.

archetype.value: Rek'Sai plays as a burrowing diver who closes distance and damages targets up close.

axis.value: Rek'Sai can take short trades with Queen's Wrath’s next three empowered basic attacks.

winCondition.value: Rek'Sai can succeed in any game through how Rek'Sai is played, rather than relying on a particular team composition.

spikes.why: Rek'Sai’s Furious Bite gains bonus true damage at maximum Fury.

bait.why: Rek'Sai cannot use Void Rush’s untargetable lunge while it is on cooldown, leaving a window to act against her.

mistakes.value: Rek'Sai players should not clear slowly, because Rek'Sai already has a slow early clear and can lose Scuttle if they take too long.
Rek'Sai loses Furious Bite’s bonus true damage by casting it before reaching maximum Fury.
